overview: The Industrial Foundry is the manufacturing engine of Sanctus Seru, producing decree-approved goods for military and civic use.
history: Constructed to centralize Seru’s industrial output under doctrinal control.
Arcane-reinforced forges were added to stabilize high-energy fabrication.
Purity-screened assembly lines were introduced to prevent ideological corruption.
Praetorian industrial overseers were integrated to enforce decree compliance.
hooks: A forge overheats, threatening a resonance cascade.
An assembly line reports a purity ward destabilization.
A Praetorian overseer requests assistance with a production edict.
A shipment of decree-approved materials goes missing.
